title: Sublimity
description: Sublimity Eau de parfum opens with the lush warmth of coconut nectar and ylang ylang blossom. Like a beach only 4WD can get to, it breaks into a elevated heart of sea salt and sandalwood, before holding you in the close kiss of full sun.

title: The Magazine
description: EVERYTHING POSSIBLE VOL. 2 Our second magazine is a dedication to Sublimity–the scent of full sun on warm wet skin–and to its origin home of Hawai'i. Made through exchange with Hawai'i's creatives of today, its new collaborative works reveal threads of connection to a sublime land and even more sublime way of seeing it

title: Disfruta
description: Disfruta Eau de parfum swirls ecstatic top notes of passionfruit pulp and neroli with the warm heart of mezcal and white cedwarwood. Finishing like a craft cocktail, it wraps you in a rush of sparkling cold—as if ice melting down glass.

title: Lil Softie
description: Sweet, lactonic and bright with top notes of pink pepper and cereal milk, before wrapping you in a skin-close, ambery musk of ambroxan, clean cottons and us.

title: Lovely and a Little Twisted
description: Lovely and a little twisted is like decadence wrapped in a dream. It begins with the inviting warmth of rose milk and candied pistachio, then twists into a hypnotic body of velvety patchouli, aromatic oud and amber resin.

title: Somewhere but Nowhere
description: Somewhere but nowhere is our ode to Americana. A story of grit, lonesomeness and grace, its heart of bold cedarwood steeps with crisp notes of cardamom and black tea, made soft around the edges by a little vanilla cream.

title: Candelabra Set
description: With which to experience your candles. Crafted in collaboration with ceramic artist, Christian Moses, the Candelabra is sculpted from a delicate patchwork of 40 clay pieces, shaped and painted by hand. Each one-of-a-kind, a study of all the ways we come together to hold light.

title: The Discovery Set
description: A wardrobe of new realities, the Discovery Set includes our five Eau de parfums.

title: LORE Fragrance Discovery Set
description: A wardrobe of new realities, the Discovery Set includes LORE's four Eau de parfums.

title: Everything Set in Bag
description: A wardrobe of new realities, the Everything Set with Bag includes four Eau de parfums—Sublimity, Disfruta, Lovely and a little twisted, and Somewhere but nowhere.

title: Holder Object
description: The Holder Object is an exploration of the unexpected forms softness takes, of the unconventional ways the world sometimes holds. It's also a devotion to craft—made in Los Angeles of solid Walnut, each whorled by the rings of new growth, finished by hand and engraved with the LORE squiq.

title: Build Your Travel Bundle
description: You're more than one mood. Build a kit of two — the ones that feel like you, ready whenever you reach for them.
